factors.name: Prior clinical efficacy
factors.requiredEvidence: Randomized Phase 1/2 report, control-arm data, effect sizes, confidence intervals, clinical relevance benchmarks.
factors.scoreRule: Higher if human benefit is larger, reliable, clinically meaningful and reproducible.
factors.criticalRisk: Bias, weak control, excessive dropout or exploratory-only positive signals.

factors.name: Expected patient benefit and counterevidence
factors.requiredEvidence: Negative/neutral trials, alternative explanations, baseline imbalance, placebo patterns and trial amendments.
factors.scoreRule: Higher if credible counterhypotheses are tested and the treatment effect remains defensible.
factors.criticalRisk: Plausible unaddressed explanation that could negate Phase 3 efficacy.

factors.name: Trial design and statistical strength
factors.requiredEvidence: Pivotal protocol and statistical analysis plan, primary endpoint, comparator, power assumptions and sample size.
factors.scoreRule: Higher for adequate power under conservative effects, validated endpoint and prespecified analysis.
factors.criticalRisk: Endpoint mismatch, multiplicity or underpowered pivotal design.

factors.name: Mechanism, dose and reproducibility
factors.requiredEvidence: Human PK/PD, exposure response, target engagement and supported pivotal-dose selection.
factors.scoreRule: Higher for mechanistic coherence at tolerable clinically attained drug exposure.
factors.criticalRisk: Unverified human target activity or dose-limiting toxicity.

factors.name: Safety and tolerability
factors.requiredEvidence: Earlier trial arm-level serious events, tolerability, discontinuation and independent efficacy replication.
factors.scoreRule: Higher for acceptable tolerability and consistent benefit across independent evidence.
factors.criticalRisk: Unresolved serious toxicity or nonreplicated signal.
